lines.offer: A map of the country round {hall}: the lie of the land, and the places the clerk thinks worth knowing.
lines.owned: You have copied the map of the country round {hall}.
lines.bought: The clerk rolls out a map of the country round {hall} and you copy it into yours for {price}. {places}
lines.nothing_marked: Nothing on it you did not know of, but the ground is drawn in.
lines.nothing_new: The clerk's map of the country round {hall} shows nothing yours does not.
lines.already: You have already copied the map at {hall}.
lines.poor: The map is {price}, and you do not have it.

lines.welcome: The Guild hall at {hall}. A board of gates, ranked worst first, and a clerk who has seen too many of them.
lines.empty: Every gate the Guild knows of is shut. The clerk looks almost disappointed.
lines.no_hall: There is no Guild hall here.
lines.taken: The clerk writes it down: the company is to shut {gate}. {gold} when it is done.
lines.full: You have as much work in hand as anyone should. Finish something first.
lines.not_open: {gate} is not open yet. The Guild does not pay for gates nobody can walk into.
lines.muster_raised: {gate} is an S-rank gate. The Guild is raising a muster at {hall}: kingdoms, soldiers and anyone strong enough, waiting until there are enough of them to go in.
lines.muster_line: The muster at {hall} for {gate}: {strength} of {needed} gathered{state}.
lines.muster_joined: The company stands with the muster at {hall}. When you go into {gate}, they go in with you.
lines.muster_with_you: {count} of the muster go into {gate} beside you.
lines.muster_won: The muster at {hall} went into {gate} without you, and shut it.
lines.muster_lost: The muster at {hall} went into {gate} without you. Few came out, and the gate broke behind them.
lines.muster_shut: The company and the muster at {hall} shut {gate} together.
lines.contract_void: Somebody else shut {gate}. The Guild tears up your contract.
